Useful numbers for England.

In immediate danger, call 999.

Helplines like Victim Support, Rape Crisis and the domestic abuse lines are independent charities. They will not ask about your immigration status, and helping you does not depend on going to the police. Being a victim of crime is never illegal, whatever your status.

Emergency, right now
Police, fire, ambulance, coastguard
999
Free, 24/7, any phone. 112 works exactly the same. Location is passed automatically.
Call

No English on a 999 call
Say "Help" then your language
Say for example "Help, Turkish". The operator connects an interpreter. Stay on the line while it goes quiet.
Cannot speak safely
Call 999, then press 55
On a mobile, stay on the line and press 55 when prompted: the call transfers to police. On a landline stay silent; it stays connected about 45 seconds after hanging up.
Call

999 BSL · Relay UK 18000
Video relay at 999bsl.co.uk, no registration. Or register for emergencySMS in advance: text "register" to 999, then text 999 in an emergency.
